mapper.select: SELECT board_game_item_id FROM rent WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND status = 'rent' LIMIT 1

SELECT r.rent_id, r.board_game_id, bg.name AS board_game_name, r.board_game_item_id, i.cabinet_id, r.status, r.rented_at FROM rent r JOIN board_game bg ON bg.board_game_id = r.board_game_id LEFT JOIN board_game_item i ON i.item_id = r.board_game_item_id WHERE r.room_number = #{roomNumber} AND r.returned_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status = 'using' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.rented_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE rent SET returned_at = NOW(), play_time_sec = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - rented_at))::INT WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND returned_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT board_game_id FROM rent WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND returned_at IS NULL

SELECT b.cabinet_id AS cabinet_number, r.status AS rent_status FROM rent r LEFT JOIN board_game_item b ON r.board_game_item_id = b.item_id WHERE r.room_number = #{roomNumber} AND r.status IN ('rent', 'using') ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status = 'using' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1;
SELECT rent_id, status, board_game_id, board_game_item_id FROM rent WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND status IN ('rent', 'using') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'using' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rent SET status = 'using' WHERE rent_id = #{rentId} AND status = 'rent'
UPDATE rent SET status = 'returned', returned_at = NOW(), play_time_sec = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - rented_at))::INT WHERE rent_id = #{rentId} AND status = 'using' AND returned_at IS NULL
